headline: Final payment for 43 North Canal St. accessibility ramp, $15,000 for 1935 Mack Fire Truck Restoration, and FY27 full applications.
summary: The agenda covers FY27 full application review, a staff transition, and a pickleball court update. Naomi Klayman's last day is Wednesday, December 2.
items: Welcome new member Patty Normand, Conservation Commission representative
FY27 full application review: overview, next steps, and timeline
Administrator transition: Naomi Klayman's last day Wednesday, December 2

Hiring process: posting the position and selection
One Holyoke CDC, 43 North Canal St. accessibility ramp: final payment
Chair's update: City Council Ordinance Committee meeting (October 14)
Discussion of hybrid meetings and best practices for posting and sharing minutes and video

City Council order: $15,000 to complete the 1935 Mack Fire Truck Restoration
Committee Rules amendment (officer term limits): City Solicitor review, sent October 19
Website migration: CPA pages on City of Holyoke website
